title: The sick leave
premise: Me says they have a fever and can't call; Mummy has seen their location on the cricket ground via location sharing.

title: The grey hoodie
premise: Mummy washed the daughter's favourite hoodie and it 'shrunk', conveniently to Mummy's size.

title: The Swiggy address
premise: Daughter says she's at home cooking; Mummy, who is at home, says the Swiggy delivery guy just called her because the address is Mummy's.

title: The turmeric stain
premise: Daughter panics about a haldi stain on her white kurta; Mummy gives a remedy, then says it's the old Diwali stain because she wore that kurta.

title: The unread call
premise: Daughter ignores Mummy's calls and says she was in a meeting; Mummy says she saw her 'last seen' and Instagram story posted 2 minutes ago.

title: The cold dinner
premise: Daughter skips dinner for a deadline and says she'll just sleep; Mummy says Ok, then reveals paneer is already arriving at her PG, paid.

title: The Nykaa lipstick
premise: Daughter claims she never bought the new lipstick; Mummy says it arrived in her name so she already tested the shade and it suits her better.

title: The tagged photo
premise: Daughter says she stayed in studying; Mummy says a cousin tagged her at a cafe, and Mummy has already liked the photo.

title: The UPI request
premise: Daughter asks Mummy for 500 rupees for 'books'; Mummy says she'll send it, then notes the exact amount matches the concert ticket she saw in her Bookmyshow email on the shared tablet.

title: The Netflix profile
premise: Daughter says she's studying for exams; Mummy notes Netflix on the shared account shows episode 9, and Mummy is only on episode 4, so no spoilers.

title: The charger swap
premise: Mummy asks for the white charger; daughter says it's hers; Mummy says she gave her the working one in March.
